Name: Golden Apple
Author: iamsaulc
Description:
[size=4][b][center]Golden Apple[/center][/b][/size]
[b]A[/b]dds Golden Apples inspired by Minecraft, attempting to adapt their effects as closely as possible within the mechanics of Stardew Valley.

Golden Apple trees can be purchased in the Desert and will produce these special fruits. Eating a Golden Apple grants powerful temporary buffs inspired by Minecraft’s golden apples, adapted as closely as possible to Stardew Valley’s buff system.

These apples provide bonuses such as increased luck, speed, defense, attack, and immunity for a limited time, making them a rare and valuable food item.

The goal of this mod is to recreate the idea of the Golden Apple while still fitting naturally within Stardew Valley’s gameplay and balance.

[b][u]Report Bugs[/u][/b]

To report an error, please use the appropriate section and provide as many details as possible about the issue encountered. It is also essential to attach the error log, which should be uploaded to the following link: [url=https://smapi.io/log][SMAPI log parser][/url].
